summary: Password field with a localized show/hide button. It does not enforce strength rules: those are the responsibility of the consumer and the server.
whenNotToUse: OTP codes or short PINs: use TextField with inputMode="numeric" and autoComplete="one-time-code".

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Use "new-password" for sign-up and password change.

props.name: label, description, errorMessage, value, onChange, isRequired, minLength, validate…

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components TextField (except type).

keyboard.action: From the field to the show/hide button.
Toggles visibility without losing the value.

accessibility: The button is a real <button> with the localized label “Mostra/Nascondi password”.
The state is conveyed by the label change.
responsive: Button with a target ≥ 24 px; 16 px font to avoid zooming on iOS.
customization: Same classes as TextField; icons from lucide-react.
commonMistakes: Treating client-side minLength as a security check.
